name: speclock-scaffold
description: pi agent router monorepo: agentd (scheduler daemon), backend (HTTP gateway), web (dashboard).

scripts.test: npm test -w @speclock-scaffold/drivers && npm test -w @speclock-scaffold/preflight && npm test -w @speclock-scaffold/agentd && npm test -w @speclock-scaffold/backend
scripts.test:ci: npm test -w @speclock-scaffold/drivers && npm test -w @speclock-scaffold/preflight && npm run test:unit -w @speclock-scaffold/agentd
scripts.check: npm run check:security && npm run test:ci
